# Python packages pinned for PlatformIO builds in CI (see build.yml).
# The pioarduino platform (display) installs the "pioarduino" core into ~/.platformio/penv
# and links with it. pioarduino 6.2.x brings SCons 4.11.1, which dropped
# SCons.Tool.FortranCommon and fails the link ("No module named ..."). 6.1.19 uses SCons 4.8.1
# and meets platform 55.03.39's ">=6.1.19" requirement.
pioarduino==6.1.19
